title: advance_state + changed_at_counter update has crash window (not atomic)
description: In ChatStore::create() and update_last_message_at(), advance_state() is called first (auto-commits), then changed_at_counter is updated in a separate statement. A crash between the two leaves changed_at_counter=0, making the chat invisible to Chat/changes consumers until another update occurs. Same pattern exists in contact store. Fix: wrap both operations in an explicit transaction.
